feedbackMechanism.howToSendFeedback: Answer the Customer Feedback Form and drop it in the Suggestion Box at the CSWDO.
feedbackMechanism.howFeedbackIsProcessed: Every 4:30pm the Info Desk Officer opens the drop box, compiles all forms and submits them to the Administrative Officer IV. Feedback requiring an answer is forwarded to the relevant division or section, which must answer within three (3) working days of receipt. The office's answer is then relayed to the client.

services.title: Limited Financial Assistance / Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situations (AICS)
services.description: Limited cash extended to clients in crisis due to death, illness, calamity or other disasters that befell the family. It also covers assistance for transportation, education and livelihood for those who cannot qualify under the Self-Employment Assistance Program.
services.office: City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO)
services.whoMayAvail: Residents of Legazpi City in need of financial assistance

requirements.item: Proof of identity (old Voter's ID or certification, UMID, driver's licence, 4Ps ID, barangay ID, national ID, or any other ID with name, picture and date of birth). Original, returned after validation.
requirements.whereToSecure: PhilHealth / COMELEC / GSIS / SSS / LTO / Pag-IBIG / Post Office / Philippine Statistics Authority / DSWD / Barangay

requirements.item: Barangay Certification of Indigency or Residency, original
requirements.whereToSecure: Barangay Hall

requirements.item: For medical assistance: Medical Certificate, abstract, prescription, quotation, laboratory order or hospital bill. Photocopy and original, returned after validation.
requirements.whereToSecure: Hospital Records Division or Billing Section where the patient is confined, or the attending physician

requirements.item: For educational assistance: Certificate of Enrolment. Photocopy and original, returned after validation.
requirements.whereToSecure: School Registrar's Office where the student is enrolled

requirements.item: For burial assistance: Death Certificate, original, returned after validation
requirements.whereToSecure: Local Civil Registrar or National Statistics Office (NSO)

requirements.item: CSWDO's Certificate of Eligibility (CE) form
requirements.whereToSecure: CSWDO

requirements.item: Authorisation letter, if a representative will claim the cash
requirements.whereToSecure: Client listed on the Certificate of Eligibility

steps.agency: Search for the client's General Intake Sheet (GIS) in the database and files, and route the client to the section concerned.

steps.client: Submit for interview and present the required documents.
steps.agency: Conduct a detailed interview and assessment of the case. If the client does not qualify, inform them immediately after the assessment.

If the client qualifies, gather collateral information through home visits (if needed), phone calls and texts, then refer the case with complete documents to the Emergency / Disaster Assistance Section (EDAS).
Prepare the Certificate of Eligibility (CE) for the client to sign, and submit it with complete documents to the Admin Division as the basis for a cash advance.

steps.client: Wait to be told the schedule of release.
steps.agency: Submit a batch of Certificates of Eligibility to the Head of Office and the City Mayor's Office for signature, then prepare and process the cash advance and inform EDAS once funds are available.
EDAS informs all clients to claim their assistance and coordinates with the sections, then releases the financial assistance to the client.

statedTotals.processingTime: 2 working days and 4 hours and 35 minutes

notes: If you are outside the City, tell the CSWDO when you can return to Legazpi to claim the assistance. If you have an appointment elsewhere, leave an authorisation letter and your ID with a family member who will claim the cash.
The charter marks several steps as paused-clock, meaning the processing time is suspended while the office waits on something outside its control.
verifyNotes: Steps sum to 2 days, 4 hrs. & 25 minutes against a stated total of 2 working days and 4 hours and 35 minutes, a gap of 10 minutes. A step duration is likely misread or a step is missing.
The charter names eleven section staff for these steps rather than assigning one per step; the steps record the section, per ADR 0002.

services.title: Certificate of Indigency, assessment report, social case study or referral
services.description: Documents issued by registered social workers and authorised social welfare staff, which clients use to seek help from other agencies for education, burial, medical, counselling, psychiatric, legal, shelter and livelihood needs, and for correcting errors in birth certificates and marriage contracts. Receiving agencies include Simon of Cyrene, the Provincial Social Welfare and Sweepstake Office, the IBP, the Public Attorney's Office and other hospitals, agencies, foundations and NGOs. The extent and amount of assistance depends on the receiving party, which may also decline the request.

services.title: PhilHealth Universal Health Care certification of financial capability
services.description: Enrolment of new members and renewal of existing members through a certification issued by a CSWDO social worker after a thorough assessment in accordance with the DOH classification of indigence. With the Universal Health Care Act of 2019, the City's coverage has expanded to most qualified persons in the City, including college students.

services.title: Solo Parent ID
services.description: Issuance of Solo Parent Identification Cards to qualified residents. The charter lists thirteen categories of solo parent, each with its own supporting document.
services.office: City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO)

requirements.item: Proof of identity (old Voter's ID or certification, UMID, driver's licence, 4Ps ID, barangay ID, national ID, or any other ID with name, picture and date of birth). Original, returned after validation.
requirements.whereToSecure: PhilHealth / COMELEC / GSIS / SSS / LTO / Pag-IBIG / Post Office / Philippine Statistics Authority / DSWD / Barangay

requirements.item: Birth Certificate of the child or children
requirements.whereToSecure: Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) or Local Civil Registrar (LCR)

requirements.item: Barangay Certificate of Residency
requirements.whereToSecure: Barangay

requirements.item: Two (2) identical 1x1 pictures
requirements.whereToSecure: Photo centre

requirements.item: Sworn affidavit declaring that the solo parent is not cohabiting with a partner and has sole parental care and support of the child or children
requirements.whereToSecure: Public Attorney's Office (PAO) or private attorney

requirements.item: The supporting document for your category: medical record of an incapacitated spouse; judicial decree of legal separation or affidavit of two disinterested persons; decree of nullity, annulment or recognition of foreign divorce; marriage certificate or affidavit plus police or barangay record of abandonment; Overseas Employment Certificate, passport stamps showing twelve continuous months of overseas work and employment contract; CENOMAR; proof of guardianship, foster care or adoption; death certificate or records evidencing disappearance of the parent or guardian for at least six months; or medical record of pregnancy.
requirements.whereToSecure: Doctor or specialist / Court / PAO or private attorney / PNP or Barangay / OWWA / Employer / PSA or LCR / DSWD or Court / OB or doctor

steps.agency: Assist the client to the Solo Parent Unit.

steps.client: Submit for interview, assessment and orientation.
steps.agency: Ask questions to determine whether the client qualifies. If not, inform them.

steps.client: Wait, and answer the questions accurately.
steps.agency: Conduct collateral information gathering through home visits (if needed), phone calls and texts.
If the client qualifies, receive and review the application with requirements.
Process the Solo Parent ID and submit it to the Head of Office and the City Mayor for signature.
steps.personResponsible: City Social Welfare and Development Officer

steps.client: Return to the CSWDO on being notified.
steps.agency: Inform the client to claim the ID, then issue the Solo Parent ID.

notes: The charter marks the collateral-information and signature steps as paused-clock.
verifyNotes: Steps sum to 2 days & 28 minutes against a stated 2 working days and 41 minutes, a gap of 13 minutes. A step duration is likely misread or a step is missing.
The final two agency actions both show 5 minutes in the source and are combined here into one 10-minute step.
